issue.masthead: no. 159 · North Hollow · sunrise 07:20 · waxing crescent

pieces.title: Freeze alert posted for hollows and valleys
pieces.body: The regional weather station has posted a freeze warning for low-lying agricultural areas across the northern Finger Lakes basin tonight. Clear skies and calm surface winds will promote rapid radiative cooling after sunset, with valley temperatures expected to fall between thirty and thirty-two degrees before dawn. Tender outdoor garden crops require immediate protection.

pieces.title: On bedsheets over garden peppers
pieces.body: "Old cotton bedsheets hold the ground warmth twice as well as plastic tarps, and they do not crush the brittle pepper stems when the night dew settles heavy. Just make sure you anchor every corner with a flat fieldstone so the midnight lake breeze does not carry them away into the woods."

pieces.title: Bedroom radiator bled and operational
pieces.body: Nora bled the upstairs bedroom radiator yesterday morning, collecting nearly a cup of cloudy water and air before the brass valve began hissing clear water. The iron ribs warmed evenly from top to bottom within twenty minutes of the thermostat calling for heat, eliminating the cold corner by the north window.

pieces.title: Bushel crates gathered from the carriage barn
pieces.body: Twelve slatted pine apple crates were brought down from the dry carriage barn loft and scrubbed with salt water. Two cracked corner cleats were reinforced with short brass screws, and the boxes now sit stacked under the kitchen porch roof. They will hold the sorted Northern Spy apples for Sunday morning pressing.

pieces.title: apples in the kitchen
pieces.body: three russet apples are sitting on the scale. they smell like brown sugar and rain. nora peeled one with her pocket knife and gave the core to the compost bucket. the kettle on the back burner has a thin rim of lime inside. it will need vinegar soon. nobody boiled it today.
